commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "f4afaff647ad5ceaf55d21e8f17a2ee06042b2c7"
cd frontend
npm ci
npm install --save-dev vitest@^5.0.1 @vitejs/plugin-react@^4.7.0 typescript@^5.9.3 vite@^6.4.3
npm update
npm audit fix
npm install --save-dev prettier@3.8.4
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); for (const k of ['@vitejs/plugin-react','typescript','vite','vitest']) { if (!p.devDependencies?.[k]) throw new Error(k+' must be a devDependency'); if (p.dependencies?.[k]) throw new Error(k+' must not be a runtime dependency'); } if (!p.devDependencies.vitest.startsWith('^5.')) throw new Error('vitest must be on v5');"
cd ..
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$changed" = $'frontend/package-lock.json\nfrontend/package.json'

set -euo pipefail
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-deps-publish-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npm audit --audit-level=moderate
npm run format:check
npm run lint
npm run knip
npm test
npm run build
npx playwright install chromium
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium e2e/smoke
cd ..
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$changed" = $'frontend/package-lock.json\nfrontend/package.json'

set -euo pipefail
git add frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Update frontend development dependencies'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-frontend-deps-20260919
